bugs.title: Desktop VEC video flickers to song artwork during unstable clips
bugs.symptom: Some desktop VEC clips flash between video and the song artwork underneath during unstable playback or clip handoff.
working_comparisons: Two other tested songs without flicker
bugs.root_cause: Video ownership could become temporarily ambiguous during startup, stall recovery, or handoff, exposing the desktop artwork background before a replacement video was stably playing.
bugs.fix_summary: Keep the desktop artwork background suppressed for the full period the video system owns the stage, including recovery and handoff, and reassert the lock against competing style mutations.
bugs.future_repair: Inspect desktop video ownership, desktopVideoArtworkLock, watchdog state, and stage background mutations before changing a song recipe or special-casing an asset.

bugs.title: Desktop VEC media flickers and video does not trigger
bugs.symptom: Desktop VEC playback can flicker between song artwork, graphics, and video states, while intended VEC videos fail to trigger or start. On Firefox desktop, song graphics may also fail to appear and VEC videos may neither appear nor start.

working_comparisons: Desktop browser/device combinations where VEC assets render normally
bugs.root_cause: Unknown. Investigation targets include desktop VEC renderer/media lifecycle, asset handoff state, video readiness/play triggering, browser autoplay or play() behavior, and competing artwork fallback/transition state. Renewed flicker may represent a regression of SR-BUG-0001.
bugs.fix_summary: No verified fix is recorded yet. Current repair must address both flicker and failed video triggering, with Firefox desktop explicitly included in verification.
bugs.future_repair: Trace selected VEC assets from eligibility through render/playback. Log image/video load state, play() success or failure, fallback activation, stage ownership, and browser. Verify Firefox, Chrome, and Edge desktop plus mixed image/video handoffs and unattended playback before marking fixed.

bugs.title: Desktop clean runtime removes login and account interface
bugs.symptom: Desktop users lose the User ID/password login entry point and account/session interface after routing into the clean desktop runtime.
working_comparisons: Standard V2 runtime with auth/session/profile stack
bugs.root_cause: The desktop clean runtime omitted both the .v2-header-actions mount point and the auth/session/profile scripts, so the login control had nowhere to mount and auth UI never initialized.
bugs.fix_summary: Initial repair restores the desktop header action slot and existing auth/session/profile CSS and scripts while preserving the clean desktop VEC/audio runtime.
bugs.future_repair: If desktop login disappears again, verify desktop routing target, .v2-header-actions, v2-header-login.js, v2-auth-sheet.js, and v2-session-manager.js before changing Cognito or backend auth.
